# NomadWealth Private Setup Kit

This is a noindex, static onboarding guide for a buyer-owned NomadWealth deployment.

- Start: /index.html
- Prerequisites: /guide/01-prerequisites.html
- Neon database: /guide/02-neon-database.html
- Vercel deploy: /guide/03-deploy-to-vercel.html
- Environment variables: /guide/04-environment-variables.html
- Setup wizard: /guide/05-setup-wizard.html
- Lite vs Pro: /guide/06-license-and-lite-vs-pro.html
- Import: /guide/07-import-your-data.html
- Optional keys and cron: /guide/08-optional-keys-and-cron.html
- Custom domain: /guide/09-custom-domain.html
- Updating: /guide/10-updating.html
- Troubleshooting: /troubleshooting.html
- Security checklist: /security-checklist.html
- Privacy: /privacy.html

The guide collects no credentials, financial data, analytics, cookies, or telemetry. The URL is unlisted, not authenticated.
